name: How long does a typical window rough opening repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window rough opening repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window rough opening repair varies significantly based on the extent of the damage. Minor repairs, like replacing a few shims or small sections of wood, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive damage, involving structural elements like headers or multiple studs, could extend to several days, especially if new framing needs to be custom-fitted. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage severity. Minor repairs might take hours to a day, while extensive structural issues could take several days.
